title: 4754 Reid Rd North Clarington Open House Video Tour
description:
Welcome to 4754 Reid Road North, a private retreat nestled on just over 38 acres of land in the Municipality of Clarington in Durham Region.

Perfect for those looking for a secluded, personal paradise, this home is surrounded by extensive lawns and forests, and has its own private pond.

A beautiful bungalow with stunning views of the outdoor property, a covered porch wraps around from the front entrance, along the west side of the home, and to the south-facing back yard area overlooking the pond.

Freshly painted and recently updated, the main level opens with an inviting reception area with double coat closet leading into the sun-filled, open-concept principal room. Combining a dining area, living room, and kitchen, the vaulted ceiling and a wall of south-facing windows give this room a light, airy feeling with ceiling fans circulating air throughout the space, while a gas fireplace spreads cozy warmth.

A hardwood floor defines the space for the living area, while a beautiful tiled floor flows throughout the kitchen and dining area, front foyer, and through to an adjacent laundry room with access to the garage.

A walk-out to the south-facing deck is found off the living room area, and completing this space is a recently updated kitchen with quartz counter tops, tiled back splash, ample cabinetry storage, stainless steel appliances, and double under mount sink. A huge walk-in pantry is also found just off the kitchen area.

The master bedroom has a stunning view of the pond and forested area. This sun-filled oasis has its own walk-out to a back deck and yard access, is finished with hardwood floors, and is complete with a 4-pc ensuite with soaker tub, separate shower area, modern vanity, and a linen and toiletry storage closet.

This level also features a 2-pc powder room and a light-filled secondary bedroom, both located off the front foyer area.

The finished lower level features a huge sun-filled recreation area with a walk-out to a flagstone patio, a 3-pc washroom, and two huge bedrooms with plenty of closet space.

Situated on a beautiful rural property, this home is surrounded by incredible natural beauty. Ideal for those looking for a tranquil setting away from the hustle and bustle of the urban lifestyle, the towns of Newtonville and Orono are just short drives away for shopping and other neighbourhood amenities - as is Hwy 35/115 for commuters.  

For more information, contact Jeanette Barrett at (905) 706-2932, or Christina Arcangioli at (905) 723-5944, both of Keller Williams Energy Real Estate Brokerage.
author: Open House 24
